806.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Minh:: Do you believe humans will discover extraterrestrial microbial life on Mars, Phong?
Phong:: Scientists say that robotic rovers on Mars have detected subsurface water and organic compounds, so microbial existence might be plausible.
Minh:: How will technological inventions reshape our everyday communication in fifty years?
Phong:: We might communicate via real-time three-dimensional holographic projections instead of handheld video screens.
Minh:: Will language barriers completely dissolve?
Phong:: Certainly! Implantable neural translation earbuds will translate spoken languages instantaneously into your native tongue.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Artificial intelligence and autonomous robotic systems are ushering in the Fourth Industrial Revolution, fundamentally transforming healthcare, manufacturing, and exploratory science. In cutting-edge hospitals, machine-learning algorithms analyze radiological scans to detect early-stage malignant tumors with unprecedented accuracy surpassing human specialists. Surgical robotic systems assist surgeons in conducting micro-invasive interventions with sub-millimeter precision. Concurrently, generative AI tools democratize creative writing and code development. However, ethicists caution that AI development must be strictly aligned with human values and safety standards.

807.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ CUỐI HỌC KÌ II - LỚP 8
807.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Minh:: Do you believe humans will discover extraterrestrial microbial life on Mars, Phong?
Phong:: Scientists say that robotic rovers on Mars have detected subsurface water and organic compounds, so microbial existence might be plausible.
Minh:: How will technological inventions reshape our everyday communication in fifty years?
Phong:: We might communicate via real-time three-dimensional holographic projections instead of handheld video screens.
Minh:: Will language barriers completely dissolve?
Phong:: Certainly! Implantable neural translation earbuds will translate spoken languages instantaneously into your native tongue.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Artificial intelligence and autonomous robotic systems are ushering in the Fourth Industrial Revolution, fundamentally transforming healthcare, manufacturing, and exploratory science. In cutting-edge hospitals, machine-learning algorithms analyze radiological scans to detect early-stage malignant tumors with unprecedented accuracy surpassing human specialists. Surgical robotic systems assist surgeons in conducting micro-invasive interventions with sub-millimeter precision. Concurrently, generative AI tools democratize creative writing and code development. However, ethicists caution that AI development must be strictly aligned with human values and safety standards.

807.readingText: The International Space Station (ISS) is a remarkable testament to peaceful international scientific cooperation. Flying approximately 400 kilometers above the Earth at a blistering orbital speed of 28,000 kilometers per hour, the football-field-sized laboratory circles our planet every 90 minutes. Since November 2000, rotating crews of international astronauts and cosmonauts have inhabited the station continuously, conducting pioneering investigations in microgravity physics, human biology, botany, and material sciences. Discoveries made aboard the ISS have contributed significantly to terrestrial medical treatments, water purification technologies, and advanced solar cells. Furthermore, the station serves as a crucial testing ground for physiological countermeasures required for future multi-year human expeditions to the Moon and Mars.

808.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Minh:: Do you believe humans will discover extraterrestrial microbial life on Mars, Phong?
Phong:: Scientists say that robotic rovers on Mars have detected subsurface water and organic compounds, so microbial existence might be plausible.
Minh:: How will technological inventions reshape our everyday communication in fifty years?
Phong:: We might communicate via real-time three-dimensional holographic projections instead of handheld video screens.
Minh:: Will language barriers completely dissolve?
Phong:: Certainly! Implantable neural translation earbuds will translate spoken languages instantaneously into your native tongue.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Artificial intelligence and autonomous robotic systems are ushering in the Fourth Industrial Revolution, fundamentally transforming healthcare, manufacturing, and exploratory science. In cutting-edge hospitals, machine-learning algorithms analyze radiological scans to detect early-stage malignant tumors with unprecedented accuracy surpassing human specialists. Surgical robotic systems assist surgeons in conducting micro-invasive interventions with sub-millimeter precision. Concurrently, generative AI tools democratize creative writing and code development. However, ethicists caution that AI development must be strictly aligned with human values and safety standards.

Flying approximately 400 kilometers above the Earth at a blistering orbital speed of 28,000 kilometers per hour, the football-field-sized laboratory circles our planet every 90 minutes. 809.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Minh:: Do you believe humans will discover extraterrestrial microbial life on Mars, Phong?
Phong:: Scientists say that robotic rovers on Mars have detected subsurface water and organic compounds, so microbial existence might be plausible.
Minh:: How will technological inventions reshape our everyday communication in fifty years?
Phong:: We might communicate via real-time three-dimensional holographic projections instead of handheld video screens.
Minh:: Will language barriers completely dissolve?
Phong:: Certainly! Implantable neural translation earbuds will translate spoken languages instantaneously into your native tongue.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Artificial intelligence and autonomous robotic systems are ushering in the Fourth Industrial Revolution, fundamentally transforming healthcare, manufacturing, and exploratory science. In cutting-edge hospitals, machine-learning algorithms analyze radiological scans to detect early-stage malignant tumors with unprecedented accuracy surpassing human specialists. Surgical robotic systems assist surgeons in conducting micro-invasive interventions with sub-millimeter precision. Concurrently, generative AI tools democratize creative writing and code development. However, ethicists caution that AI development must be strictly aligned with human values and safety standards.

Minh:: Do you believe humans will discover extraterrestrial microbial life on Mars, Phong?

Minh:: How will technological inventions reshape our everyday communication in fifty years?
Phong:: We might communicate via real-time three-dimensional holographic projections instead of handheld video screens.
Minh:: Will language barriers completely dissolve?
Phong:: Certainly! Implantable neural translation earbuds will translate spoken languages instantaneously into your native tongue.

Artificial intelligence and autonomous robotic systems are ushering in the Fourth Industrial Revolution, fundamentally transforming healthcare, manufacturing, and exploratory science. In cutting-edge hospitals, machine-learning algorithms analyze radiological scans to detect early-stage malignant tumors with unprecedented accuracy surpassing human specialists. Surgical robotic systems assist surgeons in conducting micro-invasive interventions with sub-millimeter precision. Concurrently, generative AI tools democratize creative writing and code development. However, ethicists caution that AI development must be strictly aligned with human values and safety standards.

812.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Minh:: Do you believe humans will discover extraterrestrial microbial life on Mars, Phong?
Phong:: Scientists say that robotic rovers on Mars have detected subsurface water and organic compounds, so microbial existence might be plausible.
Minh:: How will technological inventions reshape our everyday communication in fifty years?
Phong:: We might communicate via real-time three-dimensional holographic projections instead of handheld video screens.
Minh:: Will language barriers completely dissolve?
Phong:: Certainly! Implantable neural translation earbuds will translate spoken languages instantaneously into your native tongue.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Artificial intelligence and autonomous robotic systems are ushering in the Fourth Industrial Revolution, fundamentally transforming healthcare, manufacturing, and exploratory science. In cutting-edge hospitals, machine-learning algorithms analyze radiological scans to detect early-stage malignant tumors with unprecedented accuracy surpassing human specialists. Surgical robotic systems assist surgeons in conducting micro-invasive interventions with sub-millimeter precision. Concurrently, generative AI tools democratize creative writing and code development. However, ethicists caution that AI development must be strictly aligned with human values and safety standards.

Flying approximately 400 kilometers above the Earth at a blistering orbital speed of 28,000 kilometers per hour, the football-field-sized laboratory circles our planet every 90 minutes. 813.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ CUỐI HỌC KÌ II - LỚP 8
813.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Minh:: Do you believe humans will discover extraterrestrial microbial life on Mars, Phong?
Phong:: Scientists say that robotic rovers on Mars have detected subsurface water and organic compounds, so microbial existence might be plausible.
Minh:: How will technological inventions reshape our everyday communication in fifty years?
Phong:: We might communicate via real-time three-dimensional holographic projections instead of handheld video screens.
Minh:: Will language barriers completely dissolve?
Phong:: Certainly! Implantable neural translation earbuds will translate spoken languages instantaneously into your native tongue.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Artificial intelligence and autonomous robotic systems are ushering in the Fourth Industrial Revolution, fundamentally transforming healthcare, manufacturing, and exploratory science. In cutting-edge hospitals, machine-learning algorithms analyze radiological scans to detect early-stage malignant tumors with unprecedented accuracy surpassing human specialists. Surgical robotic systems assist surgeons in conducting micro-invasive interventions with sub-millimeter precision. Concurrently, generative AI tools democratize creative writing and code development. However, ethicists caution that AI development must be strictly aligned with human values and safety standards.

814.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ CUỐI HỌC KÌ II - LỚP 8
814.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Minh:: Do you believe humans will discover extraterrestrial microbial life on Mars, Phong?
Phong:: Scientists say that robotic rovers on Mars have detected subsurface water and organic compounds, so microbial existence might be plausible.
Minh:: How will technological inventions reshape our everyday communication in fifty years?
Phong:: We might communicate via real-time three-dimensional holographic projections instead of handheld video screens.
Minh:: Will language barriers completely dissolve?
Phong:: Certainly! Implantable neural translation earbuds will translate spoken languages instantaneously into your native tongue.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Artificial intelligence and autonomous robotic systems are ushering in the Fourth Industrial Revolution, fundamentally transforming healthcare, manufacturing, and exploratory science. In cutting-edge hospitals, machine-learning algorithms analyze radiological scans to detect early-stage malignant tumors with unprecedented accuracy surpassing human specialists. Surgical robotic systems assist surgeons in conducting micro-invasive interventions with sub-millimeter precision. Concurrently, generative AI tools democratize creative writing and code development. However, ethicists caution that AI development must be strictly aligned with human values and safety standards.

814.readingText: The International Space Station (ISS) is a remarkable testament to peaceful international scientific cooperation. Flying approximately 400 kilometers above the Earth at a blistering orbital speed of 28,000 kilometers per hour, the football-field-sized laboratory circles our planet every 90 minutes. Since November 2000, rotating crews of international astronauts and cosmonauts have inhabited the station continuously, conducting pioneering investigations in microgravity physics, human biology, botany, and material sciences. Discoveries made aboard the ISS have contributed significantly to terrestrial medical treatments, water purification technologies, and advanced solar cells. Furthermore, the station serves as a crucial testing ground for physiological countermeasures required for future multi-year human expeditions to the Moon and Mars.

815.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Minh:: Do you believe humans will discover extraterrestrial microbial life on Mars, Phong?
Phong:: Scientists say that robotic rovers on Mars have detected subsurface water and organic compounds, so microbial existence might be plausible.
Minh:: How will technological inventions reshape our everyday communication in fifty years?
Phong:: We might communicate via real-time three-dimensional holographic projections instead of handheld video screens.
Minh:: Will language barriers completely dissolve?
Phong:: Certainly! Implantable neural translation earbuds will translate spoken languages instantaneously into your native tongue.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Artificial intelligence and autonomous robotic systems are ushering in the Fourth Industrial Revolution, fundamentally transforming healthcare, manufacturing, and exploratory science. In cutting-edge hospitals, machine-learning algorithms analyze radiological scans to detect early-stage malignant tumors with unprecedented accuracy surpassing human specialists. Surgical robotic systems assist surgeons in conducting micro-invasive interventions with sub-millimeter precision. Concurrently, generative AI tools democratize creative writing and code development. However, ethicists caution that AI development must be strictly aligned with human values and safety standards.

Flying approximately 400 kilometers above the Earth at a blistering orbital speed of 28,000 kilometers per hour, the football-field-sized laboratory circles our planet every 90 minutes. 816.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ CUỐI HỌC KÌ II - LỚP 8
816.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Minh:: Do you believe humans will discover extraterrestrial microbial life on Mars, Phong?
Phong:: Scientists say that robotic rovers on Mars have detected subsurface water and organic compounds, so microbial existence might be plausible.
Minh:: How will technological inventions reshape our everyday communication in fifty years?
Phong:: We might communicate via real-time three-dimensional holographic projections instead of handheld video screens.
Minh:: Will language barriers completely dissolve?
Phong:: Certainly! Implantable neural translation earbuds will translate spoken languages instantaneously into your native tongue.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Artificial intelligence and autonomous robotic systems are ushering in the Fourth Industrial Revolution, fundamentally transforming healthcare, manufacturing, and exploratory science. In cutting-edge hospitals, machine-learning algorithms analyze radiological scans to detect early-stage malignant tumors with unprecedented accuracy surpassing human specialists. Surgical robotic systems assist surgeons in conducting micro-invasive interventions with sub-millimeter precision. Concurrently, generative AI tools democratize creative writing and code development. However, ethicists caution that AI development must be strictly aligned with human values and safety standards.

Flying approximately 400 kilometers above the Earth at a blistering orbital speed of 28,000 kilometers per hour, the football-field-sized laboratory circles our planet every 90 minutes. Since November 2000, rotating crews of international astronauts and cosmonauts have inhabited the station continuously, conducting pioneering investigations in microgravity physics, human biology, botany, and material sciences. === PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Minh:: Do you believe humans will discover extraterrestrial microbial life on Mars, Phong?
Phong:: Scientists say that robotic rovers on Mars have detected subsurface water and organic compounds, so microbial existence might be plausible.
Minh:: How will technological inventions reshape our everyday communication in fifty years?
Phong:: We might communicate via real-time three-dimensional holographic projections instead of handheld video screens.
Minh:: Will language barriers completely dissolve?
Phong:: Certainly! Implantable neural translation earbuds will translate spoken languages instantaneously into your native tongue.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Artificial intelligence and autonomous robotic systems are ushering in the Fourth Industrial Revolution, fundamentally transforming healthcare, manufacturing, and exploratory science. In cutting-edge hospitals, machine-learning algorithms analyze radiological scans to detect early-stage malignant tumors with unprecedented accuracy surpassing human specialists. Surgical robotic systems assist surgeons in conducting micro-invasive interventions with sub-millimeter precision. Concurrently, generative AI tools democratize creative writing and code development. However, ethicists caution that AI development must be strictly aligned with human values and safety standards.

818.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ CUỐI HỌC KÌ II - LỚP 8
818.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Minh:: Do you believe humans will discover extraterrestrial microbial life on Mars, Phong?
Phong:: Scientists say that robotic rovers on Mars have detected subsurface water and organic compounds, so microbial existence might be plausible.
Minh:: How will technological inventions reshape our everyday communication in fifty years?
Phong:: We might communicate via real-time three-dimensional holographic projections instead of handheld video screens.
Minh:: Will language barriers completely dissolve?
Phong:: Certainly! Implantable neural translation earbuds will translate spoken languages instantaneously into your native tongue.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Artificial intelligence and autonomous robotic systems are ushering in the Fourth Industrial Revolution, fundamentally transforming healthcare, manufacturing, and exploratory science. In cutting-edge hospitals, machine-learning algorithms analyze radiological scans to detect early-stage malignant tumors with unprecedented accuracy surpassing human specialists. Surgical robotic systems assist surgeons in conducting micro-invasive interventions with sub-millimeter precision. Concurrently, generative AI tools democratize creative writing and code development. However, ethicists caution that AI development must be strictly aligned with human values and safety standards.
818.audioScriptPart1:

819.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Minh:: Do you believe humans will discover extraterrestrial microbial life on Mars, Phong?
Phong:: Scientists say that robotic rovers on Mars have detected subsurface water and organic compounds, so microbial existence might be plausible.
Minh:: How will technological inventions reshape our everyday communication in fifty years?
Phong:: We might communicate via real-time three-dimensional holographic projections instead of handheld video screens.
Minh:: Will language barriers completely dissolve?
Phong:: Certainly! Implantable neural translation earbuds will translate spoken languages instantaneously into your native tongue.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Artificial intelligence and autonomous robotic systems are ushering in the Fourth Industrial Revolution, fundamentally transforming healthcare, manufacturing, and exploratory science. In cutting-edge hospitals, machine-learning algorithms analyze radiological scans to detect early-stage malignant tumors with unprecedented accuracy surpassing human specialists. Surgical robotic systems assist surgeons in conducting micro-invasive interventions with sub-millimeter precision. Concurrently, generative AI tools democratize creative writing and code development. However, ethicists caution that AI development must be strictly aligned with human values and safety standards.

820.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Minh:: Do you believe humans will discover extraterrestrial microbial life on Mars, Phong?
Phong:: Scientists say that robotic rovers on Mars have detected subsurface water and organic compounds, so microbial existence might be plausible.
Minh:: How will technological inventions reshape our everyday communication in fifty years?
Phong:: We might communicate via real-time three-dimensional holographic projections instead of handheld video screens.
Minh:: Will language barriers completely dissolve?
Phong:: Certainly! Implantable neural translation earbuds will translate spoken languages instantaneously into your native tongue.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
Artificial intelligence and autonomous robotic systems are ushering in the Fourth Industrial Revolution, fundamentally transforming healthcare, manufacturing, and exploratory science. In cutting-edge hospitals, machine-learning algorithms analyze radiological scans to detect early-stage malignant tumors with unprecedented accuracy surpassing human specialists. Surgical robotic systems assist surgeons in conducting micro-invasive interventions with sub-millimeter precision. Concurrently, generative AI tools democratize creative writing and code development. However, ethicists caution that AI development must be strictly aligned with human values and safety standards.

901.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Tuấn:: What career path do you intend to pursue after graduating from high school, Alex?
Alex:: I am passionate about software engineering and artificial intelligence development.
Tuấn:: Why did you choose that particular profession?
Alex:: Because digital automation and AI are revolutionizing healthcare, finance, and green energy management.
Tuấn:: What skills will be crucial for 21st-century professionals?
Alex:: Besides technological coding expertise, adaptability, creative problem-solving, and emotional empathy will be indispensable.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
In July 1980, Vietnamese cosmonaut Pham Tuan made history by becoming the very first Asian citizen to journey into outer space aboard the Soviet spacecraft Soyuz 37. During his eight-day orbital mission docking with the Salyut 6 space station, Lieutenant General Pham Tuan conducted critical scientific experiments in microgravity botany, tracking the growth of Vietnamese Azolla pinnata water ferns, as well as atmospheric photography and Earth observation. His historic cosmic voyage demonstrated national technological courage, inspired millions of Vietnamese youngsters to pursue aerospace sciences, and laid the foundations for Viet Nam's space research development.

901.readingText: The James Webb Space Telescope (JWST), stationed approximately 1.5 million kilometers from Earth at the Second Lagrange Point (L2), represents humanity's premier space observatory. Equipped with a gigantic 6.5-meter gold-coated beryllium primary mirror and highly sensitive infrared scientific instruments, the telescope can peer through cosmic dust clouds to observe the earliest stars and galaxies formed shortly after the Big Bang over 13.5 billion years ago. Furthermore, JWST analyzes atmospheric chemical signatures of distant exoplanets orbiting alien stars, detecting atmospheric water vapor, carbon dioxide, and methane that could hint at habitable environments. This groundbreaking $10 billion international collaboration between NASA, ESA, and the Canadian Space Agency is unlocking the profound mysteries of cosmic evolution and humankind's place in the universe.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
In July 1980, Vietnamese cosmonaut Pham Tuan made history by becoming the very first Asian citizen to journey into outer space aboard the Soviet spacecraft Soyuz 37. During his eight-day orbital mission docking with the Salyut 6 space station, Lieutenant General Pham Tuan conducted critical scientific experiments in microgravity botany, tracking the growth of Vietnamese Azolla pinnata water ferns, as well as atmospheric photography and Earth observation. His historic cosmic voyage demonstrated national technological courage, inspired millions of Vietnamese youngsters to pursue aerospace sciences, and laid the foundations for Viet Nam's space research development.

Equipped with a gigantic 6.5-meter gold-coated beryllium primary mirror and highly sensitive infrared scientific instruments, the telescope can peer through cosmic dust clouds to observe the earliest stars and galaxies formed shortly after the Big Bang over 13.5 billion years ago. Furthermore, JWST analyzes atmospheric chemical signatures of distant exoplanets orbiting alien stars, detecting atmospheric water vapor, carbon dioxide, and methane that could hint at habitable environments. This groundbreaking $10 billion international collaboration between NASA, ESA, and the Canadian Space Agency is unlocking the profound mysteries of cosmic evolution and humankind's place in the universe.

903.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ CUỐI HỌC KÌ II - LỚP 9
903.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Tuấn:: What career path do you intend to pursue after graduating from high school, Alex?
Alex:: I am passionate about software engineering and artificial intelligence development.
Tuấn:: Why did you choose that particular profession?
Alex:: Because digital automation and AI are revolutionizing healthcare, finance, and green energy management.
Tuấn:: What skills will be crucial for 21st-century professionals?
Alex:: Besides technological coding expertise, adaptability, creative problem-solving, and emotional empathy will be indispensable.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
In July 1980, Vietnamese cosmonaut Pham Tuan made history by becoming the very first Asian citizen to journey into outer space aboard the Soviet spacecraft Soyuz 37. During his eight-day orbital mission docking with the Salyut 6 space station, Lieutenant General Pham Tuan conducted critical scientific experiments in microgravity botany, tracking the growth of Vietnamese Azolla pinnata water ferns, as well as atmospheric photography and Earth observation. His historic cosmic voyage demonstrated national technological courage, inspired millions of Vietnamese youngsters to pursue aerospace sciences, and laid the foundations for Viet Nam's space research development.

903.clozeText: The 21st-century global labor landscape is undergoing seismic shifts driven by robotic automation, artificial intelligence, and ecological sustainability mandates. Traditional repetitive manual vocations are rapidly disappearing, replaced by sophisticated machine-learning systems. Conversely, exponential demand is emerging for specialized professionals in data analytics, cybersecurity architecture, renewable energy engineering, and digital healthcare. Educational researchers emphasize that young scholars preparing for future careers must develop versatile transferable (23) ________. These encompass digital literacy, collaborative agility, and emotional empathy—attributes that algorithmic systems cannot replicate. Rather than merely chasing conventional white-collar occupations, students are encouraged to explore vocational (24) ________ programs offering hands-on technical craftsmanship. Embracing lifelong learning is essential for navigating dynamic, (25) ________ career environments in the decades (26) ________ without compromising planetary (27) ________.
903.readingText: The James Webb Space Telescope (JWST), stationed approximately 1.5 million kilometers from Earth at the Second Lagrange Point (L2), represents humanity's premier space observatory. Equipped with a gigantic 6.5-meter gold-coated beryllium primary mirror and highly sensitive infrared scientific instruments, the telescope can peer through cosmic dust clouds to observe the earliest stars and galaxies formed shortly after the Big Bang over 13.5 billion years ago. Furthermore, JWST analyzes atmospheric chemical signatures of distant exoplanets orbiting alien stars, detecting atmospheric water vapor, carbon dioxide, and methane that could hint at habitable environments. This groundbreaking $10 billion international collaboration between NASA, ESA, and the Canadian Space Agency is unlocking the profound mysteries of cosmic evolution and humankind's place in the universe.

904.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Tuấn:: What career path do you intend to pursue after graduating from high school, Alex?
Alex:: I am passionate about software engineering and artificial intelligence development.
Tuấn:: Why did you choose that particular profession?
Alex:: Because digital automation and AI are revolutionizing healthcare, finance, and green energy management.
Tuấn:: What skills will be crucial for 21st-century professionals?
Alex:: Besides technological coding expertise, adaptability, creative problem-solving, and emotional empathy will be indispensable.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
In July 1980, Vietnamese cosmonaut Pham Tuan made history by becoming the very first Asian citizen to journey into outer space aboard the Soviet spacecraft Soyuz 37. During his eight-day orbital mission docking with the Salyut 6 space station, Lieutenant General Pham Tuan conducted critical scientific experiments in microgravity botany, tracking the growth of Vietnamese Azolla pinnata water ferns, as well as atmospheric photography and Earth observation. His historic cosmic voyage demonstrated national technological courage, inspired millions of Vietnamese youngsters to pursue aerospace sciences, and laid the foundations for Viet Nam's space research development.

904.readingText: The James Webb Space Telescope (JWST), stationed approximately 1.5 million kilometers from Earth at the Second Lagrange Point (L2), represents humanity's premier space observatory. Equipped with a gigantic 6.5-meter gold-coated beryllium primary mirror and highly sensitive infrared scientific instruments, the telescope can peer through cosmic dust clouds to observe the earliest stars and galaxies formed shortly after the Big Bang over 13.5 billion years ago. Furthermore, JWST analyzes atmospheric chemical signatures of distant exoplanets orbiting alien stars, detecting atmospheric water vapor, carbon dioxide, and methane that could hint at habitable environments. This groundbreaking $10 billion international collaboration between NASA, ESA, and the Canadian Space Agency is unlocking the profound mysteries of cosmic evolution and humankind's place in the universe.

905.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ CUỐI HỌC KÌ II - LỚP 9
905.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Tuấn:: What career path do you intend to pursue after graduating from high school, Alex?
Alex:: I am passionate about software engineering and artificial intelligence development.
Tuấn:: Why did you choose that particular profession?
Alex:: Because digital automation and AI are revolutionizing healthcare, finance, and green energy management.
Tuấn:: What skills will be crucial for 21st-century professionals?
Alex:: Besides technological coding expertise, adaptability, creative problem-solving, and emotional empathy will be indispensable.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
In July 1980, Vietnamese cosmonaut Pham Tuan made history by becoming the very first Asian citizen to journey into outer space aboard the Soviet spacecraft Soyuz 37. During his eight-day orbital mission docking with the Salyut 6 space station, Lieutenant General Pham Tuan conducted critical scientific experiments in microgravity botany, tracking the growth of Vietnamese Azolla pinnata water ferns, as well as atmospheric photography and Earth observation. His historic cosmic voyage demonstrated national technological courage, inspired millions of Vietnamese youngsters to pursue aerospace sciences, and laid the foundations for Viet Nam's space research development.

905.clozeText: The 21st-century global labor landscape is undergoing seismic shifts driven by robotic automation, artificial intelligence, and ecological sustainability mandates. Traditional repetitive manual vocations are rapidly disappearing, replaced by sophisticated machine-learning systems. Conversely, exponential demand is emerging for specialized professionals in data analytics, cybersecurity architecture, renewable energy engineering, and digital healthcare. Educational researchers emphasize that young scholars preparing for future careers must develop versatile transferable (23) ________. These encompass digital literacy, collaborative agility, and emotional empathy—attributes that algorithmic systems cannot replicate. Rather than merely chasing conventional white-collar occupations, students are encouraged to explore vocational (24) ________ programs offering hands-on technical craftsmanship. Embracing lifelong learning is essential for navigating dynamic, (25) ________ career environments in the decades (26) ________ without compromising planetary (27) ________.
905.readingText: The James Webb Space Telescope (JWST), stationed approximately 1.5 million kilometers from Earth at the Second Lagrange Point (L2), represents humanity's premier space observatory. Equipped with a gigantic 6.5-meter gold-coated beryllium primary mirror and highly sensitive infrared scientific instruments, the telescope can peer through cosmic dust clouds to observe the earliest stars and galaxies formed shortly after the Big Bang over 13.5 billion years ago. Furthermore, JWST analyzes atmospheric chemical signatures of distant exoplanets orbiting alien stars, detecting atmospheric water vapor, carbon dioxide, and methane that could hint at habitable environments. This groundbreaking $10 billion international collaboration between NASA, ESA, and the Canadian Space Agency is unlocking the profound mysteries of cosmic evolution and humankind's place in the universe.

906.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ CUỐI HỌC KÌ II - LỚP 9
906.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Tuấn:: What career path do you intend to pursue after graduating from high school, Alex?
Alex:: I am passionate about software engineering and artificial intelligence development.
Tuấn:: Why did you choose that particular profession?
Alex:: Because digital automation and AI are revolutionizing healthcare, finance, and green energy management.
Tuấn:: What skills will be crucial for 21st-century professionals?
Alex:: Besides technological coding expertise, adaptability, creative problem-solving, and emotional empathy will be indispensable.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
In July 1980, Vietnamese cosmonaut Pham Tuan made history by becoming the very first Asian citizen to journey into outer space aboard the Soviet spacecraft Soyuz 37. During his eight-day orbital mission docking with the Salyut 6 space station, Lieutenant General Pham Tuan conducted critical scientific experiments in microgravity botany, tracking the growth of Vietnamese Azolla pinnata water ferns, as well as atmospheric photography and Earth observation. His historic cosmic voyage demonstrated national technological courage, inspired millions of Vietnamese youngsters to pursue aerospace sciences, and laid the foundations for Viet Nam's space research development.

906.clozeText: The 21st-century global labor landscape is undergoing seismic shifts driven by robotic automation, artificial intelligence, and ecological sustainability mandates. Conversely, exponential demand is emerging for specialized professionals in data analytics, cybersecurity architecture, renewable energy engineering, and digital healthcare. Educational researchers emphasize that young scholars preparing for future careers must develop versatile transferable (23) ________. These encompass digital literacy, collaborative agility, and emotional empathy—attributes that algorithmic systems cannot replicate. Rather than merely chasing conventional white-collar occupations, students are encouraged to explore vocational (24) ________ programs offering hands-on technical craftsmanship. 906.readingText: The James Webb Space Telescope (JWST), stationed approximately 1.5 million kilometers from Earth at the Second Lagrange Point (L2), represents humanity's premier space observatory. Equipped with a gigantic 6.5-meter gold-coated beryllium primary mirror and highly sensitive infrared scientific instruments, the telescope can peer through cosmic dust clouds to observe the earliest stars and galaxies formed shortly after the Big Bang over 13.5 billion years ago. Furthermore, JWST analyzes atmospheric chemical signatures of distant exoplanets orbiting alien stars, detecting atmospheric water vapor, carbon dioxide, and methane that could hint at habitable environments. This groundbreaking $10 billion international collaboration between NASA, ESA, and the Canadian Space Agency is unlocking the profound mysteries of cosmic evolution and humankind's place in the universe.

907.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Tuấn:: What career path do you intend to pursue after graduating from high school, Alex?
Alex:: I am passionate about software engineering and artificial intelligence development.
Tuấn:: Why did you choose that particular profession?
Alex:: Because digital automation and AI are revolutionizing healthcare, finance, and green energy management.
Tuấn:: What skills will be crucial for 21st-century professionals?
Alex:: Besides technological coding expertise, adaptability, creative problem-solving, and emotional empathy will be indispensable.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
In July 1980, Vietnamese cosmonaut Pham Tuan made history by becoming the very first Asian citizen to journey into outer space aboard the Soviet spacecraft Soyuz 37. During his eight-day orbital mission docking with the Salyut 6 space station, Lieutenant General Pham Tuan conducted critical scientific experiments in microgravity botany, tracking the growth of Vietnamese Azolla pinnata water ferns, as well as atmospheric photography and Earth observation. His historic cosmic voyage demonstrated national technological courage, inspired millions of Vietnamese youngsters to pursue aerospace sciences, and laid the foundations for Viet Nam's space research development.

907.readingText: The James Webb Space Telescope (JWST), stationed approximately 1.5 million kilometers from Earth at the Second Lagrange Point (L2), represents humanity's premier space observatory. Equipped with a gigantic 6.5-meter gold-coated beryllium primary mirror and highly sensitive infrared scientific instruments, the telescope can peer through cosmic dust clouds to observe the earliest stars and galaxies formed shortly after the Big Bang over 13.5 billion years ago. Furthermore, JWST analyzes atmospheric chemical signatures of distant exoplanets orbiting alien stars, detecting atmospheric water vapor, carbon dioxide, and methane that could hint at habitable environments. This groundbreaking $10 billion international collaboration between NASA, ESA, and the Canadian Space Agency is unlocking the profound mysteries of cosmic evolution and humankind's place in the universe.

909.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Tuấn:: What career path do you intend to pursue after graduating from high school, Alex?
Alex:: I am passionate about software engineering and artificial intelligence development.
Tuấn:: Why did you choose that particular profession?
Alex:: Because digital automation and AI are revolutionizing healthcare, finance, and green energy management.
Tuấn:: What skills will be crucial for 21st-century professionals?
Alex:: Besides technological coding expertise, adaptability, creative problem-solving, and emotional empathy will be indispensable.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
In July 1980, Vietnamese cosmonaut Pham Tuan made history by becoming the very first Asian citizen to journey into outer space aboard the Soviet spacecraft Soyuz 37. During his eight-day orbital mission docking with the Salyut 6 space station, Lieutenant General Pham Tuan conducted critical scientific experiments in microgravity botany, tracking the growth of Vietnamese Azolla pinnata water ferns, as well as atmospheric photography and Earth observation. His historic cosmic voyage demonstrated national technological courage, inspired millions of Vietnamese youngsters to pursue aerospace sciences, and laid the foundations for Viet Nam's space research development.

909.clozeText: The 21st-century global labor landscape is undergoing seismic shifts driven by robotic automation, artificial intelligence, and ecological sustainability mandates. Traditional repetitive manual vocations are rapidly disappearing, replaced by sophisticated machine-learning systems. Conversely, exponential demand is emerging for specialized professionals in data analytics, cybersecurity architecture, renewable energy engineering, and digital healthcare. Educational researchers emphasize that young scholars preparing for future careers must develop versatile transferable (23) ________. Rather than merely chasing conventional white-collar occupations, students are encouraged to explore vocational (24) ________ programs offering hands-on technical craftsmanship. Embracing lifelong learning is essential for navigating dynamic, (25) ________ career environments in the decades (26) ________ without compromising planetary (27) ________.
909.readingText: The James Webb Space Telescope (JWST), stationed approximately 1.5 million kilometers from Earth at the Second Lagrange Point (L2), represents humanity's premier space observatory. Equipped with a gigantic 6.5-meter gold-coated beryllium primary mirror and highly sensitive infrared scientific instruments, the telescope can peer through cosmic dust clouds to observe the earliest stars and galaxies formed shortly after the Big Bang over 13.5 billion years ago. Furthermore, JWST analyzes atmospheric chemical signatures of distant exoplanets orbiting alien stars, detecting atmospheric water vapor, carbon dioxide, and methane that could hint at habitable environments. This groundbreaking $10 billion international collaboration between NASA, ESA, and the Canadian Space Agency is unlocking the profound mysteries of cosmic evolution and humankind's place in the universe.

910.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ CUỐI HỌC KÌ II - LỚP 9
910.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Tuấn:: What career path do you intend to pursue after graduating from high school, Alex?
Alex:: I am passionate about software engineering and artificial intelligence development.
Tuấn:: Why did you choose that particular profession?
Alex:: Because digital automation and AI are revolutionizing healthcare, finance, and green energy management.
Tuấn:: What skills will be crucial for 21st-century professionals?
Alex:: Besides technological coding expertise, adaptability, creative problem-solving, and emotional empathy will be indispensable.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
In July 1980, Vietnamese cosmonaut Pham Tuan made history by becoming the very first Asian citizen to journey into outer space aboard the Soviet spacecraft Soyuz 37. During his eight-day orbital mission docking with the Salyut 6 space station, Lieutenant General Pham Tuan conducted critical scientific experiments in microgravity botany, tracking the growth of Vietnamese Azolla pinnata water ferns, as well as atmospheric photography and Earth observation. His historic cosmic voyage demonstrated national technological courage, inspired millions of Vietnamese youngsters to pursue aerospace sciences, and laid the foundations for Viet Nam's space research development.

910.clozeText: The 21st-century global labor landscape is undergoing seismic shifts driven by robotic automation, artificial intelligence, and ecological sustainability mandates. Conversely, exponential demand is emerging for specialized professionals in data analytics, cybersecurity architecture, renewable energy engineering, and digital healthcare. Educational researchers emphasize that young scholars preparing for future careers must develop versatile transferable (23) ________. These encompass digital literacy, collaborative agility, and emotional empathy—attributes that algorithmic systems cannot replicate. Rather than merely chasing conventional white-collar occupations, students are encouraged to explore vocational (24) ________ programs offering hands-on technical craftsmanship. Embracing lifelong learning is essential for navigating dynamic, (25) ________ career environments in the decades (26) ________ without compromising planetary (27) ________.
910.readingText: The James Webb Space Telescope (JWST), stationed approximately 1.5 million kilometers from Earth at the Second Lagrange Point (L2), represents humanity's premier space observatory. Equipped with a gigantic 6.5-meter gold-coated beryllium primary mirror and highly sensitive infrared scientific instruments, the telescope can peer through cosmic dust clouds to observe the earliest stars and galaxies formed shortly after the Big Bang over 13.5 billion years ago. Furthermore, JWST analyzes atmospheric chemical signatures of distant exoplanets orbiting alien stars, detecting atmospheric water vapor, carbon dioxide, and methane that could hint at habitable environments. This groundbreaking $10 billion international collaboration between NASA, ESA, and the Canadian Space Agency is unlocking the profound mysteries of cosmic evolution and humankind's place in the universe.

911.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Tuấn:: What career path do you intend to pursue after graduating from high school, Alex?
Alex:: I am passionate about software engineering and artificial intelligence development.
Tuấn:: Why did you choose that particular profession?

912.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Tuấn:: What career path do you intend to pursue after graduating from high school, Alex?
Alex:: I am passionate about software engineering and artificial intelligence development.
Tuấn:: Why did you choose that particular profession?
Alex:: Because digital automation and AI are revolutionizing healthcare, finance, and green energy management.
Tuấn:: What skills will be crucial for 21st-century professionals?
Alex:: Besides technological coding expertise, adaptability, creative problem-solving, and emotional empathy will be indispensable.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
In July 1980, Vietnamese cosmonaut Pham Tuan made history by becoming the very first Asian citizen to journey into outer space aboard the Soviet spacecraft Soyuz 37. During his eight-day orbital mission docking with the Salyut 6 space station, Lieutenant General Pham Tuan conducted critical scientific experiments in microgravity botany, tracking the growth of Vietnamese Azolla pinnata water ferns, as well as atmospheric photography and Earth observation. His historic cosmic voyage demonstrated national technological courage, inspired millions of Vietnamese youngsters to pursue aerospace sciences, and laid the foundations for Viet Nam's space research development.

912.clozeText: The 21st-century global labor landscape is undergoing seismic shifts driven by robotic automation, artificial intelligence, and ecological sustainability mandates. Traditional repetitive manual vocations are rapidly disappearing, replaced by sophisticated machine-learning systems. Conversely, exponential demand is emerging for specialized professionals in data analytics, cybersecurity architecture, renewable energy engineering, and digital healthcare. Educational researchers emphasize that young scholars preparing for future careers must develop versatile transferable (23) ________. These encompass digital literacy, collaborative agility, and emotional empathy—attributes that algorithmic systems cannot replicate. Rather than merely chasing conventional white-collar occupations, students are encouraged to explore vocational (24) ________ programs offering hands-on technical craftsmanship. Embracing lifelong learning is essential for navigating dynamic, (25) ________ career environments in the decades (26) ________ without compromising planetary (27) ________.
912.readingText: The James Webb Space Telescope (JWST), stationed approximately 1.5 million kilometers from Earth at the Second Lagrange Point (L2), represents humanity's premier space observatory. Equipped with a gigantic 6.5-meter gold-coated beryllium primary mirror and highly sensitive infrared scientific instruments, the telescope can peer through cosmic dust clouds to observe the earliest stars and galaxies formed shortly after the Big Bang over 13.5 billion years ago. Furthermore, JWST analyzes atmospheric chemical signatures of distant exoplanets orbiting alien stars, detecting atmospheric water vapor, carbon dioxide, and methane that could hint at habitable environments. This groundbreaking $10 billion international collaboration between NASA, ESA, and the Canadian Space Agency is unlocking the profound mysteries of cosmic evolution and humankind's place in the universe.

913.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ CUỐI HỌC KÌ II - LỚP 9
913.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Tuấn:: What career path do you intend to pursue after graduating from high school, Alex?
Alex:: I am passionate about software engineering and artificial intelligence development.
Tuấn:: Why did you choose that particular profession?
Alex:: Because digital automation and AI are revolutionizing healthcare, finance, and green energy management.
Tuấn:: What skills will be crucial for 21st-century professionals?
Alex:: Besides technological coding expertise, adaptability, creative problem-solving, and emotional empathy will be indispensable.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
In July 1980, Vietnamese cosmonaut Pham Tuan made history by becoming the very first Asian citizen to journey into outer space aboard the Soviet spacecraft Soyuz 37. During his eight-day orbital mission docking with the Salyut 6 space station, Lieutenant General Pham Tuan conducted critical scientific experiments in microgravity botany, tracking the growth of Vietnamese Azolla pinnata water ferns, as well as atmospheric photography and Earth observation. His historic cosmic voyage demonstrated national technological courage, inspired millions of Vietnamese youngsters to pursue aerospace sciences, and laid the foundations for Viet Nam's space research development.

913.clozeText: The 21st-century global labor landscape is undergoing seismic shifts driven by robotic automation, artificial intelligence, and ecological sustainability mandates. Traditional repetitive manual vocations are rapidly disappearing, replaced by sophisticated machine-learning systems. Conversely, exponential demand is emerging for specialized professionals in data analytics, cybersecurity architecture, renewable energy engineering, and digital healthcare. Educational researchers emphasize that young scholars preparing for future careers must develop versatile transferable (23) ________. These encompass digital literacy, collaborative agility, and emotional empathy—attributes that algorithmic systems cannot replicate. Rather than merely chasing conventional white-collar occupations, students are encouraged to explore vocational (24) ________ programs offering hands-on technical craftsmanship. Embracing lifelong learning is essential for navigating dynamic, (25) ________ career environments in the decades (26) ________ without compromising planetary (27) ________.
913.readingText: The James Webb Space Telescope (JWST), stationed approximately 1.5 million kilometers from Earth at the Second Lagrange Point (L2), represents humanity's premier space observatory. Equipped with a gigantic 6.5-meter gold-coated beryllium primary mirror and highly sensitive infrared scientific instruments, the telescope can peer through cosmic dust clouds to observe the earliest stars and galaxies formed shortly after the Big Bang over 13.5 billion years ago. Furthermore, JWST analyzes atmospheric chemical signatures of distant exoplanets orbiting alien stars, detecting atmospheric water vapor, carbon dioxide, and methane that could hint at habitable environments. This groundbreaking $10 billion international collaboration between NASA, ESA, and the Canadian Space Agency is unlocking the profound mysteries of cosmic evolution and humankind's place in the universe.

914.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ CUỐI HỌC KÌ II - LỚP 9
914.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Tuấn:: What career path do you intend to pursue after graduating from high school, Alex?
Alex:: I am passionate about software engineering and artificial intelligence development.
Tuấn:: Why did you choose that particular profession?
Alex:: Because digital automation and AI are revolutionizing healthcare, finance, and green energy management.
Tuấn:: What skills will be crucial for 21st-century professionals?
Alex:: Besides technological coding expertise, adaptability, creative problem-solving, and emotional empathy will be indispensable.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
In July 1980, Vietnamese cosmonaut Pham Tuan made history by becoming the very first Asian citizen to journey into outer space aboard the Soviet spacecraft Soyuz 37. During his eight-day orbital mission docking with the Salyut 6 space station, Lieutenant General Pham Tuan conducted critical scientific experiments in microgravity botany, tracking the growth of Vietnamese Azolla pinnata water ferns, as well as atmospheric photography and Earth observation. His historic cosmic voyage demonstrated national technological courage, inspired millions of Vietnamese youngsters to pursue aerospace sciences, and laid the foundations for Viet Nam's space research development.

914.readingText: The James Webb Space Telescope (JWST), stationed approximately 1.5 million kilometers from Earth at the Second Lagrange Point (L2), represents humanity's premier space observatory. Equipped with a gigantic 6.5-meter gold-coated beryllium primary mirror and highly sensitive infrared scientific instruments, the telescope can peer through cosmic dust clouds to observe the earliest stars and galaxies formed shortly after the Big Bang over 13.5 billion years ago. Furthermore, JWST analyzes atmospheric chemical signatures of distant exoplanets orbiting alien stars, detecting atmospheric water vapor, carbon dioxide, and methane that could hint at habitable environments. This groundbreaking $10 billion international collaboration between NASA, ESA, and the Canadian Space Agency is unlocking the profound mysteries of cosmic evolution and humankind's place in the universe.

915.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Tuấn:: What career path do you intend to pursue after graduating from high school, Alex?
Alex:: I am passionate about software engineering and artificial intelligence development.
Tuấn:: Why did you choose that particular profession?
Alex:: Because digital automation and AI are revolutionizing healthcare, finance, and green energy management.
Tuấn:: What skills will be crucial for 21st-century professionals?
Alex:: Besides technological coding expertise, adaptability, creative problem-solving, and emotional empathy will be indispensable.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
In July 1980, Vietnamese cosmonaut Pham Tuan made history by becoming the very first Asian citizen to journey into outer space aboard the Soviet spacecraft Soyuz 37. During his eight-day orbital mission docking with the Salyut 6 space station, Lieutenant General Pham Tuan conducted critical scientific experiments in microgravity botany, tracking the growth of Vietnamese Azolla pinnata water ferns, as well as atmospheric photography and Earth observation. His historic cosmic voyage demonstrated national technological courage, inspired millions of Vietnamese youngsters to pursue aerospace sciences, and laid the foundations for Viet Nam's space research development.

915.readingText: The James Webb Space Telescope (JWST), stationed approximately 1.5 million kilometers from Earth at the Second Lagrange Point (L2), represents humanity's premier space observatory. Equipped with a gigantic 6.5-meter gold-coated beryllium primary mirror and highly sensitive infrared scientific instruments, the telescope can peer through cosmic dust clouds to observe the earliest stars and galaxies formed shortly after the Big Bang over 13.5 billion years ago. Furthermore, JWST analyzes atmospheric chemical signatures of distant exoplanets orbiting alien stars, detecting atmospheric water vapor, carbon dioxide, and methane that could hint at habitable environments. This groundbreaking $10 billion international collaboration between NASA, ESA, and the Canadian Space Agency is unlocking the profound mysteries of cosmic evolution and humankind's place in the universe.

916.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Tuấn:: What career path do you intend to pursue after graduating from high school, Alex?
Alex:: I am passionate about software engineering and artificial intelligence development.
Tuấn:: Why did you choose that particular profession?
Alex:: Because digital automation and AI are revolutionizing healthcare, finance, and green energy management.
Tuấn:: What skills will be crucial for 21st-century professionals?
Alex:: Besides technological coding expertise, adaptability, creative problem-solving, and emotional empathy will be indispensable.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
In July 1980, Vietnamese cosmonaut Pham Tuan made history by becoming the very first Asian citizen to journey into outer space aboard the Soviet spacecraft Soyuz 37. During his eight-day orbital mission docking with the Salyut 6 space station, Lieutenant General Pham Tuan conducted critical scientific experiments in microgravity botany, tracking the growth of Vietnamese Azolla pinnata water ferns, as well as atmospheric photography and Earth observation. His historic cosmic voyage demonstrated national technological courage, inspired millions of Vietnamese youngsters to pursue aerospace sciences, and laid the foundations for Viet Nam's space research development.

916.clozeText: The 21st-century global labor landscape is undergoing seismic shifts driven by robotic automation, artificial intelligence, and ecological sustainability mandates. Rather than merely chasing conventional white-collar occupations, students are encouraged to explore vocational (24) ________ programs offering hands-on technical craftsmanship. 916.readingText: The James Webb Space Telescope (JWST), stationed approximately 1.5 million kilometers from Earth at the Second Lagrange Point (L2), represents humanity's premier space observatory. Equipped with a gigantic 6.5-meter gold-coated beryllium primary mirror and highly sensitive infrared scientific instruments, the telescope can peer through cosmic dust clouds to observe the earliest stars and galaxies formed shortly after the Big Bang over 13.5 billion years ago. Furthermore, JWST analyzes atmospheric chemical signatures of distant exoplanets orbiting alien stars, detecting atmospheric water vapor, carbon dioxide, and methane that could hint at habitable environments. This groundbreaking $10 billion international collaboration between NASA, ESA, and the Canadian Space Agency is unlocking the profound mysteries of cosmic evolution and humankind's place in the universe.

917.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ CUỐI HỌC KÌ II - LỚP 9
917.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Tuấn:: What career path do you intend to pursue after graduating from high school, Alex?
Alex:: I am passionate about software engineering and artificial intelligence development.
Tuấn:: Why did you choose that particular profession?
Alex:: Because digital automation and AI are revolutionizing healthcare, finance, and green energy management.
Tuấn:: What skills will be crucial for 21st-century professionals?
Alex:: Besides technological coding expertise, adaptability, creative problem-solving, and emotional empathy will be indispensable.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
In July 1980, Vietnamese cosmonaut Pham Tuan made history by becoming the very first Asian citizen to journey into outer space aboard the Soviet spacecraft Soyuz 37. During his eight-day orbital mission docking with the Salyut 6 space station, Lieutenant General Pham Tuan conducted critical scientific experiments in microgravity botany, tracking the growth of Vietnamese Azolla pinnata water ferns, as well as atmospheric photography and Earth observation. His historic cosmic voyage demonstrated national technological courage, inspired millions of Vietnamese youngsters to pursue aerospace sciences, and laid the foundations for Viet Nam's space research development.

917.clozeText: The 21st-century global labor landscape is undergoing seismic shifts driven by robotic automation, artificial intelligence, and ecological sustainability mandates. Traditional repetitive manual vocations are rapidly disappearing, replaced by sophisticated machine-learning systems. Conversely, exponential demand is emerging for specialized professionals in data analytics, cybersecurity architecture, renewable energy engineering, and digital healthcare. Educational researchers emphasize that young scholars preparing for future careers must develop versatile transferable (23) ________. 918.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Tuấn:: What career path do you intend to pursue after graduating from high school, Alex?
Alex:: I am passionate about software engineering and artificial intelligence development.
Tuấn:: Why did you choose that particular profession?
Alex:: Because digital automation and AI are revolutionizing healthcare, finance, and green energy management.
Tuấn:: What skills will be crucial for 21st-century professionals?
Alex:: Besides technological coding expertise, adaptability, creative problem-solving, and emotional empathy will be indispensable.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
In July 1980, Vietnamese cosmonaut Pham Tuan made history by becoming the very first Asian citizen to journey into outer space aboard the Soviet spacecraft Soyuz 37. During his eight-day orbital mission docking with the Salyut 6 space station, Lieutenant General Pham Tuan conducted critical scientific experiments in microgravity botany, tracking the growth of Vietnamese Azolla pinnata water ferns, as well as atmospheric photography and Earth observation. His historic cosmic voyage demonstrated national technological courage, inspired millions of Vietnamese youngsters to pursue aerospace sciences, and laid the foundations for Viet Nam's space research development.

918.readingText: The James Webb Space Telescope (JWST), stationed approximately 1.5 million kilometers from Earth at the Second Lagrange Point (L2), represents humanity's premier space observatory. Equipped with a gigantic 6.5-meter gold-coated beryllium primary mirror and highly sensitive infrared scientific instruments, the telescope can peer through cosmic dust clouds to observe the earliest stars and galaxies formed shortly after the Big Bang over 13.5 billion years ago. Furthermore, JWST analyzes atmospheric chemical signatures of distant exoplanets orbiting alien stars, detecting atmospheric water vapor, carbon dioxide, and methane that could hint at habitable environments. This groundbreaking $10 billion international collaboration between NASA, ESA, and the Canadian Space Agency is unlocking the profound mysteries of cosmic evolution and humankind's place in the universe.

919.typeTitle: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐÁNH GIÁ CUỐI HỌC KÌ II - LỚP 9
919.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Tuấn:: What career path do you intend to pursue after graduating from high school, Alex?
Alex:: I am passionate about software engineering and artificial intelligence development.
Tuấn:: Why did you choose that particular profession?
Alex:: Because digital automation and AI are revolutionizing healthcare, finance, and green energy management.
Tuấn:: What skills will be crucial for 21st-century professionals?
Alex:: Besides technological coding expertise, adaptability, creative problem-solving, and emotional empathy will be indispensable.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
In July 1980, Vietnamese cosmonaut Pham Tuan made history by becoming the very first Asian citizen to journey into outer space aboard the Soviet spacecraft Soyuz 37. During his eight-day orbital mission docking with the Salyut 6 space station, Lieutenant General Pham Tuan conducted critical scientific experiments in microgravity botany, tracking the growth of Vietnamese Azolla pinnata water ferns, as well as atmospheric photography and Earth observation. His historic cosmic voyage demonstrated national technological courage, inspired millions of Vietnamese youngsters to pursue aerospace sciences, and laid the foundations for Viet Nam's space research development.

919.readingText: The James Webb Space Telescope (JWST), stationed approximately 1.5 million kilometers from Earth at the Second Lagrange Point (L2), represents humanity's premier space observatory. Equipped with a gigantic 6.5-meter gold-coated beryllium primary mirror and highly sensitive infrared scientific instruments, the telescope can peer through cosmic dust clouds to observe the earliest stars and galaxies formed shortly after the Big Bang over 13.5 billion years ago. Furthermore, JWST analyzes atmospheric chemical signatures of distant exoplanets orbiting alien stars, detecting atmospheric water vapor, carbon dioxide, and methane that could hint at habitable environments. This groundbreaking $10 billion international collaboration between NASA, ESA, and the Canadian Space Agency is unlocking the profound mysteries of cosmic evolution and humankind's place in the universe.

920.audioScript:
=== PART 1: DIALOGUE ===
Tuấn:: What career path do you intend to pursue after graduating from high school, Alex?
Alex:: I am passionate about software engineering and artificial intelligence development.
Tuấn:: Why did you choose that particular profession?
Alex:: Because digital automation and AI are revolutionizing healthcare, finance, and green energy management.
Tuấn:: What skills will be crucial for 21st-century professionals?
Alex:: Besides technological coding expertise, adaptability, creative problem-solving, and emotional empathy will be indispensable.

=== PART 2: MONOLOGUE ===
In July 1980, Vietnamese cosmonaut Pham Tuan made history by becoming the very first Asian citizen to journey into outer space aboard the Soviet spacecraft Soyuz 37. During his eight-day orbital mission docking with the Salyut 6 space station, Lieutenant General Pham Tuan conducted critical scientific experiments in microgravity botany, tracking the growth of Vietnamese Azolla pinnata water ferns, as well as atmospheric photography and Earth observation. His historic cosmic voyage demonstrated national technological courage, inspired millions of Vietnamese youngsters to pursue aerospace sciences, and laid the foundations for Viet Nam's space research development.

920.clozeText: The 21st-century global labor landscape is undergoing seismic shifts driven by robotic automation, artificial intelligence, and ecological sustainability mandates. Traditional repetitive manual vocations are rapidly disappearing, replaced by sophisticated machine-learning systems. Conversely, exponential demand is emerging for specialized professionals in data analytics, cybersecurity architecture, renewable energy engineering, and digital healthcare. Educational researchers emphasize that young scholars preparing for future careers must develop versatile transferable (23) ________. These encompass digital literacy, collaborative agility, and emotional empathy—attributes that algorithmic systems cannot replicate. Rather than merely chasing conventional white-collar occupations, students are encouraged to explore vocational (24) ________ programs offering hands-on technical craftsmanship. Embracing lifelong learning is essential for navigating dynamic, (25) ________ career environments in the decades (26) ________ without compromising planetary (27) ________.
920.readingText: The James Webb Space Telescope (JWST), stationed approximately 1.5 million kilometers from Earth at the Second Lagrange Point (L2), represents humanity's premier space observatory. Equipped with a gigantic 6.5-meter gold-coated beryllium primary mirror and highly sensitive infrared scientific instruments, the telescope can peer through cosmic dust clouds to observe the earliest stars and galaxies formed shortly after the Big Bang over 13.5 billion years ago. Furthermore, JWST analyzes atmospheric chemical signatures of distant exoplanets orbiting alien stars, detecting atmospheric water vapor, carbon dioxide, and methane that could hint at habitable environments. This groundbreaking $10 billion international collaboration between NASA, ESA, and the Canadian Space Agency is unlocking the profound mysteries of cosmic evolution and humankind's place in the universe.
920.passageText:
📖 ĐOẠN VĂN ĐIỀN TỪ (CLOZE TEXT - PART 4):
The 21st-century global labor landscape is undergoing seismic shifts driven by robotic automation, artificial intelligence, and ecological sustainability mandates. Traditional repetitive manual vocations are rapidly disappearing, replaced by sophisticated machine-learning systems. Conversely, exponential demand is emerging for specialized professionals in data analytics, cybersecurity architecture, renewable energy engineering, and digital healthcare. Educational researchers emphasize that young scholars preparing for future careers must develop versatile transferable (23) ________. These encompass digital literacy, collaborative agility, and emotional empathy—attributes that algorithmic systems cannot replicate. Rather than merely chasing conventional white-collar occupations, students are encouraged to explore vocational (24) ________ programs offering hands-on technical craftsmanship. Embracing lifelong learning is essential for navigating dynamic, (25) ________ career environments in the decades (26) ________ without compromising planetary (27) ________.

📖 ĐOẠN VĂN ĐỌC HIỂU (READING COMPREHENSION - PART 5):
The James Webb Space Telescope (JWST), stationed approximately 1.5 million kilometers from Earth at the Second Lagrange Point (L2), represents humanity's premier space observatory. Equipped with a gigantic 6.5-meter gold-coated beryllium primary mirror and highly sensitive infrared scientific instruments, the telescope can peer through cosmic dust clouds to observe the earliest stars and galaxies formed shortly after the Big Bang over 13.5 billion years ago. Furthermore, JWST analyzes atmospheric chemical signatures of distant exoplanets orbiting alien stars, detecting atmospheric water vapor, carbon dioxide, and methane that could hint at habitable environments. This groundbreaking $10 billion international collaboration between NASA, ESA, and the Canadian Space Agency is unlocking the profound mysteries of cosmic evolution and humankind's place in the universe.
